column2: when driver receives DELAY_NOT_RESPONDING event for a disk

column1: while it is undergoing addition at the SCSI Transport layer
would block the I/O to that disk resulting in a deadlock. i.e the disk
addition work couldn't be completed at the SCSI Transport Layer as it
can't send any I/Os (such as Inquiry
column2: Report LUNs etc) to the disk as

column1: I/Os are blocked to this drive. Also any subsequent device removal

processed as they are in the queue to get processed after disk addition
event.
